description: navigator.hardwareConcurrency buckets. Bucket lists only: a real count is identifying, a fabricated count contradicts a timing probe, and a common bucket the host can serve is neither. Selection is clamped down to the host's real logical core count and never up: a page can measure parallel throughput, so a claim above host capability is falsified while a claim below it is not (docs/FINGERPRINTS.md section 3).
